note: Three non-equestrian campgrounds on the open hillside above the north shore of 410-acre Pleasant Creek Lake (no-wake) near Palo; swim beach and boat ramps on the lake. No daily Iowa park-entry fee. --Claude
summary: Lakeview confirmed: no site is tagged Near Water and the loops sit 150-250 m above the shore behind the park road and prairie, but official RA photos show the lake from Campground 2 sites 52 and 55 and Campground 1 site 26. No on-water candidates. Changed sites 70 -> 68, added 50 A, 100-ft max, pull-throughs, season Apr 1 - Nov 15. Pin ~1 km off: moved to the campgrounds.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview confirmed, no on-water candidates. RA tags all 68 campsites 'Near Water - no'. On NAIP the park road runs along the south side of Campground 1, with ~100-150 m of open prairie between it and the shore; Campground 2 is ~230 m from the water across prairie; Campground 3 is farther up the hill. Official RA site photos show open water past the grass from site 52 and site 55 (Campground 2's south row) and at the edge of site 26 (Campground 1's south row). Photos of sites 20, 22 and 23 show only lawn and trees. Candidates: the south rows of Campgrounds 1 and 2, about 10 sites. The pond north of Campground 2 is under 5 acres.

PIN (~1 km off): stored 42.12333,-91.81944 is south-east of all three campgrounds. RA GIS centroids: Campground 1 42.13044,-91.82288; Campground 2 42.13166,-91.82744; Campground 3 42.13334,-91.83115; NAIP shows the paved loops and pads at each. Proposed location 42.1316,-91.8264 (centroid of all 68 sites, in Campground 2).
SITE COUNT: stored ~70 rested on note prose; RA lists 68 campsites plus 4 cabins.
STATUS: RA alerts say electric sites 61 and 63 are closed through November 15, 2026 for renovations, and water is shut off for the winter, back on in late April 2027.
FEES: stored $12/$18 non-electric and $20/$26 electric match the Iowa DNR rate sheet (updated Feb 15 2026); not changed.
Note: removed the site, hookup, facilities, cabin, season and reservation text (now in fields); kept the lake, beach, ramp and no-entry-fee lines.
